content:
# 4 Ezra Chapter 7 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Latin Vulgate (Codex Sangermanensis) | **Section:** Core apocalypse — The narrow gate and fate of souls

---

**7:1** And when I-had-finished-speaking these words, the-angel was-sent to-me who-had-been-sent to-me the-nights-before,

**7:2** and he-said to-me: Rise, Ezra, and hear the-words that I-have-come to-speak to-you.

**7:3** And I-said: Speak, my-lord. And he-said to-me: There-is a-sea set-in a wide-expanse so-that it-is-deep and vast,

**7:4** but it-has-an-entrance set-in a narrow-place so-as-to-be like a-river.

**7:5** If-there-should-be one who desires to-go into the-sea either to-look upon-it or to-navigate-it, how-could-he come to the-broad-part unless he-passed-through the-narrow?

**7:6** Again, there-is a city built and set on-a-plain, and it-is-full of-all good-things;

**7:7** but its-entrance is-narrow and set in-a-precipitous-place, so-that there-is fire on-the-right-hand and deep-water on-the-left;

**7:8** and there-is only one-narrow-path between-them, that-is, between the-fire and the-water, such-that only one-person at-a-time can-walk upon-the-path.

**7:9** If-now-this-city be-given as-an inheritance to-a man, unless the-inheritor passes-through the-difficulty set-before-it, how-shall-he receive his-inheritance?

**7:10** And I-said: That-is-so, lord. And he-said to-me: So-also is-the-portion of-Israel!

**7:11** For it-was-for-Israel I-made the-world; and when-Adam transgressed my-statutes, that-which-was-made was-judged.

**7:12** And the-entrances-of-this-world were-made narrow and sorrowful and toilsome and-they-are-few and-evil, full-of-dangers and involved-in-great-hardships.

**7:13** But the-entrances-of-the-greater-world are-broad and-safe and yield the-fruit-of-immortality.

**7:14** Unless therefore the-living pass through the difficult and vain-experiences, they-can-never receive those-things that-have-been-reserved for-them.

**7:15** Now therefore why-are you disturbed, seeing that-you are-mortal? and why-are you moved, seeing that-you are-corruptible?

**7:16** And why-have-you-not-considered-in-your-heart what-is-to-come, rather than what-is-present?

**7:17** Then I-answered and-said: O LORD, my-lord, behold, you-have-ordained in-your-law that the-righteous shall-inherit these-things, but the-ungodly shall-perish.

**7:18** The-righteous therefore shall-endure straitened-things, hoping for-spacious-things; but they-who-have-done-wickedly have-suffered the-strait-things and shall-not-see the-spacious.

**7:19** And he-said to-me: You-are-not-a-judge above-God, neither-are-you-more-prudent than-the-Most-High.

**7:20** Let-the-many-perish who-are-now-alive rather-than-that-the-law-of-God which-is-set-before-them-be-neglected.

**7:21** For-God strictly-commanded those-who-came-into-the-world, when-they-came, what-they-should-do to-live and-what-they-should-observe-to-avoid punishment.

**7:22** But-they-were-not-obedient, and-spoke-against-him; they-devised-for-themselves vain-thoughts,

**7:23** and proposed-to-themselves wicked frauds; they-even-declared the-Most-High-does-not-exist, and they-knew-not his-ways;

**7:24** they-despised-his-law and rejected-his-covenants; they-have-been-unfaithful to-his-statutes and-have-not-performed-his-works.

**7:25** Therefore, Ezra, for-the-empty are-empty-things, and-for-the-full are-the-full-things.

**7:26** For-behold, the-time-shall-come, and-it-shall-be when the-signs come-to-pass which I-told-you-about before, that the-bride-shall-appear, and-she-coming-forth shall-be-seen, that-is now-withdrawn from-the-earth,

**7:27** and-whosoever-is-delivered-from-the-aforesaid-evils shall-see my-wonders.

**7:28** For-my-son the-Messiah shall-be-revealed with-those-who-are-with-him, and-shall-make-glad those-who-remain for-four-hundred-years.

**7:29** And-it-shall-be after-those-years that my-son the-Messiah shall-die, and-all-those-who-draw-human-breath.

**7:30** And-the-world-shall-be-turned-into the-primeval-silence for-seven-days as-it-was-at-the-first-beginnings; so-that no-one-shall-be-left.

**7:31** And-it-shall-be-after-seven-days that-the-age-which-is-not-yet-awake-shall-be-roused, and-that-which-is-corruptible-shall-die.

**7:32** And-the-earth-shall-give-up those-who-are-asleep-in-it, and-so-shall-the-dust-those-who-dwell-silently-in-it, and-the-storehouses-shall-give-back the-souls-which-have-been-committed-to-them.

**7:33** And-the-Most-High-shall-appear-upon-the-seat-of-judgment, and-misery-shall-pass-away, and-the-long-suffering-shall-have-an-end:

**7:34** but-judgment-only-shall-remain, truth-shall-stand, and-faithfulness-shall-grow-strong;

**7:35** and-recompense-shall-follow, and-the-reward-shall-be-manifested; righteous-deeds-shall-awake, and-unrighteous-deeds-shall-not-sleep.

**7:36** And-the-pit-of-torment-shall-appear, and-over-against-it-shall-be-the-place-of-refreshment; the-furnace-of-Gehenna-shall-be-manifest, and-over-against-it-the-paradise-of-delight.

**7:37** Then-shall-the-Most-High-say to-the-nations-that-have-been-raised-from-the-dead: See-and-understand-Whom-you-have-denied, Whom-you-have-not-served, Whose-commandments-you-have-despised!

**7:38** Look now-before-you — on-this-side delight-and-rest; on-that-side fire-and-torments! Thus-shall-he-speak to-them on-the-day-of-judgment.

**7:39** There-is-not-a day-like-that-day and-there-never-was — for-it-is-like-a-day-of-battle!

**7:40** And-that-day-shall-not-have sun nor moon nor stars,

**7:41** nor-cloud nor-thunder nor-lightning, nor-wind nor-water nor-air, nor-darkness nor-evening nor-morning,

**7:42** nor-summer nor-spring nor-heat nor-winter, nor-frost nor-cold nor-hail nor-rain nor-dew,

**7:43** nor-noon nor-night nor-dawn, nor-shining nor-brightness nor-light — save-only the-splendor-of-the-glory-of-the-Most-High, by-which-all-shall-see what-has-been-appointed.

**7:44** For-it-shall-last as-it-were for-a-week-of-years.

**7:45** This-is-my-judgment and-its-prescribed-order; and-to-thee-alone-have-I-shown-these-things.

**7:46** Then-I-answered and-said: O-LORD, I-said-then-also, and-I-say-now: Blessed-are-they-who-live-and-keep-your-commandments.

**7:47** But-what-of-those-for-whom-I-prayed? For-who-among-the-living-is-there-that-has-not-sinned, and-who-of-those-that-are-born-that-has-not-transgressed-your-covenant?

**7:48** And-now I-see-that-the-world-to-come-will-bring-delight-to-few, and-torment-to-many.

**7:49** For-an-evil-heart-has-grown-up-in-us, which-has-alienated-us-from-these-things, and-brought-us-into-corruption-and-into the-ways-of-death, and-has-shown-us the-paths-of-perdition-and-removed-us-far-from-life — and-that not a-few only, but-well-nigh-all-who-have-been-created.

**7:50** And-he-answered-me and-said: Hear-me, Ezra, and I-will-instruct-you, and-will-admonish-you-yet-again.

**7:51** For-this-cause also the-Most-High-created not-one-world-but-two.

**7:52** Inasmuch-as-you-have-said that-the-righteous-are-not-many-but-few, while-the-ungodly-abound, hear-the-explanation-thereof.

**7:53** If-you-have-very-few precious-stones, will-you-add-to-their-number lead-and-clay?

**7:54** And-I-said: Lord, how-could-that-be?

**7:55** And-he-said-to-me: Not-only-that, but-ask-the-earth-and-it-will-tell-you; deal-gently-with-it, and-it-will-speak-with-you.

**7:56** You-say-to-it: You-produce-gold-and-silver-and-copper and-also-iron-and-lead-and-clay:

**7:57** but-silver-is-more-abundant-than-gold, and-copper-than-silver, and-iron-than-copper, and-lead-than-iron, and-clay-than-lead.

**7:58** Judge-therefore-which-things-are-precious-and-to-be-desired — those-that-are-abundant-or-those-that-are-rare?

**7:59** And-I-said: O-LORD-who-rules-over-us, that-which-is-rare-is-more-precious.

**7:60** And-he-answered-me-and-said: Weigh-within-yourself-what-you-have-thought, for-he-that-has-what-is-hard-to-get-rejoices-more-than-he-that-has-what-is-plentiful.

**7:61** So-also-will-be the-judgment-which-I-have-promised; for-I-will-rejoice-over-the-few-who-shall-be-saved, inasmuch-as-these-are they-who-have-made-my-glory-to-prevail-now, and-through-them-has-my-name-been-honored.

**7:62** And-I-will-not-grieve-over-the-multitude-of-those-who-perish; for-these-are they-who-are-now-like-vapor and-who-have-become-as-flame-and-smoke — they-are-set-on-fire and-burn-hotly and-are-extinguished.

**7:63** Then-I-answered and-said: O-earth, what-have-you-brought-forth, if-the-mind-is-made-out-of-the-dust-even-as-the-other-created-things!

**7:64** For-it-were-better-that-the-dust-itself-had-been-unborn, so-that-the-mind-might-not-have-come-from-it, and-so-that-the-mind-might-not-now-bring-us-into-torment.

**7:65** But-now-I-know-not-what-is-good-for-us: whether-we-should-be-in-sorrow or-whether-we-should-be-made-glad.

**7:66** And-he-answered-me and-said: Understand-that it-is-better-for-the-present for-the-creature-to-come-into-judgment having-sinned-than-to-pass-through-life-without-sinning-and-not-be-judged.

**7:67** And-I-answered-and-said: I-know, O-LORD, that-the-Most-High-is-called-merciful, in-that-he-has-mercy-upon-those-who-have-not-yet-come-into-the-world,

**7:68** and-upon-those-who-turn-from-his-law,

**7:69** and-in-his-long-suffering and-in-his-compassion is-he-called-merciful for-ever and-ever.

**7:70** For-if-he-were-not-merciful, the-world-would-not-continue and-the-unnumbered-people-who-have-sinned would-not-be-able-to-live.

**7:71** And-he-answered-me and-said: The-Most-High-made-this-world for-the-sake-of-many, but-the-world-to-come for-the-sake-of-few.

**7:72** But-I-tell-you-a-parable, Ezra. As-when-you-ask-the-earth, and-it-says to-you: It-gives-more-clay from-which earthen-vessels-are-made but-little-dust from-which gold-comes — so-is-it-also-in-the-course-of-the-present-world.

**7:73** There-is-also another-thing I-will-tell-you. Speak-not-too-often of-the-Most-High;

**7:74** nor-consider-too-eagerly-the-things-that-concern-you-now; for-have-you-not-forgotten-what-it-is-for-a-man-to-be-judged-and-found-wanting?

**7:75** But-now rejoice-not-over-yourself in-overmeasure, and-let-it-not-pain-thee-overmuch.

**7:76** For-in-the-day-of-judgment every-man-according-to-his-merits and-deeds-shall-be-judged.

**7:77** And-I-said: What-then-shall-be-the-dividing-of-those-who-have-been-gathered?

**7:78** And-he-answered-me and-said: It-is-thus: The-souls-of-the-righteous-shall-depart-from-the-habitation-of-the-corruptible, and-shall-not-return-from-them-any-more.

**7:79** But-the-souls-of-the-wicked-shall-see-the-habitation-of-those-who-have-been-saved; they-shall-also-see-the-torment-that-awaits-them.

**7:80** Therefore-this-is-what-shall-happen: They-shall-wait-seven-days of-rest, and-after-that-seven-days-are-over, they-shall-begin-to-long-for-the-places-which-they-have-abandoned.

**7:81** And-this-is-the-order-of-those-who-have-kept-the-way-of-the-Most-High, when-they-are-separated-from-their-mortal-bodies.

**7:82** In-the-time-that-they-dwelt-in-it, they-labored-strenuously-in-serving-the-Most-High, and-withstood-danger-every-hour-that-the-law-giver-might-be-perfected.

**7:83** Therefore-this-is-the-teaching concerning-them:

**7:84** First-of-all-they-shall-see-with-great-joy the-glory-of-him-who-takes-them, for-they-shall-have-rest-in-seven-orders.

**7:85** The-first-order: they-have-striven-with-great-effort-to-overcome-the-evil-thought-which-was-formed-with-them, that-it-might-not-lead-them-astray-from-life-into-death.

**7:86** The-second-order: they-shall-see-the-wandering-of-the-souls-of-the-wicked and-the-punishment-that-awaits-them.

**7:87** The-third-order: they-shall-see-the-witness-which-he-who-formed-them-bears-concerning-them, that-when-they-were-alive-they-kept-the-law-which-was-given-to-them-in-trust.

**7:88** The-fourth-order: they-shall-understand-the-rest-which-they-now-enjoy, being-gathered-in-their-chambers-and-guarded-by-angels-in-profound-quietness, and-the-glory-which-awaits-them-in-the-last-days.

**7:89** The-fifth-order: they-shall-rejoice that-they-have-now-escaped-what-is-corruptible, and-that-they-shall-inherit-what-is-to-come, while-they-also-behold-the-narrow-and-the-toilsome through-which-they-have-passed-to-greatness-and-blessedness.

**7:90** The-sixth-order: it-shall-be-shown-to-them-how-their-face-is-to-shine-like-the-sun, and-how-they-are-to-be-made-like-the-light-of-the-stars, being-incorruptible-from-then-on.

**7:91** The-seventh-order, which-is-greater-than-all-the-aforesaid: they-shall-exult-with-confidence, they-shall-be-bold-without-confusion, and-shall-be-glad-without-fear, for-they-hasten-to-see-the-face-of-him-whom-they-served-in-life-and-from-whom-they-are-to-receive-their-reward-when-glorified.

**7:92** This-is-the-order-of-the-souls-of-the-righteous, as-henceforth-is-announced; and-the-aforesaid-are-the-ways-of-torment-which-those-who-would-not-give-heed-shall-suffer-hereafter.

**7:93** And-I-answered and-said: Will-time-therefore-be-given-to-the-souls-after-they-have-been-separated-from-the-bodies, to-see-what-you-have-told-me-concerning-them?

**7:94** And-he-said-to-me: Seven-days-of-liberty-shall-they-have, so-that-during-these-seven-days-they-may-see-the-things-of-which-you-have-been-told, and-afterward-they-shall-be-gathered-in-their-habitations.

**7:95** And-I-answered-and-said: If-I-have-found-grace-before-you, show-me-further, your-servant — whether-in-the-day-of-judgment the-righteous-will-be-able-to-intercede-for-the-wicked or-to-entreat-the-Most-High-for-them,

**7:96** the-fathers-for-their-children, or-the-children-for-their-parents, or-brothers-for-brothers, or-relatives-for-their-kinsmen, or-friends-for-those-who-are-most-dear.

**7:97** And-he-answered-me and-said: Since-you-have-found-grace-before-me, I-will-show-you-this-too. The-day-of-judgment-is-decisive and-displays-to-all-the-seal-of-truth;

**7:98** just-as-now-a-father-does-not-send-his-son, or-a-son-his-father, or-a-master-his-slave, or-a-friend-his-dearest-friend, to-be-ill or-sleep or-eat or-be-healed-in-his-stead,

**7:99** so-then-none-shall-pray-for-another-on-that-day, neither-shall-anyone-lay-a-burden-on-another; for-then-everyone-shall-bear-his-own-righteousness-and-his-own-wickedness.

**7:100** Then-I-answered-and-said: How-then-do-we-find-that-Abraham-prayed-first-for-the-people-of-Sodom, and-Moses-for-our-fathers-who-sinned-in-the-wilderness,

**7:101** and-Jesus after-him-for-Israel-in-the-days-of-Achan,

**7:102** and-Samuel and-David-for-the-destruction, and-Solomon-for-those-in-the-sanctuary,

**7:103** and-Elijah-for-those-who-received-rain, and-for-the-dead-that-he-might-live,

**7:104** and-Hezekiah-for-the-people-in-the-days-of-Sennacherib, and-many-for-many?

**7:105** So-if-the-righteous-have-prayed-for-the-wicked-in-this-present-time — when-corruption-is-grown-up-and-unrighteousness-has-increased — why-is-it-not-also-possible-in-the-future?

**7:106** And-he-answered-me and-said: This-present-world-is-not-the-end; the-fullness-of-glory-has-not-tarried-in-it; wherefore-those-who-were-strong-prayed-for-the-weak.

**7:107** But-the-day-of-judgment-shall-be-the-end-of-this-present-time and-the-beginning-of-the-immortal-time-to-come, wherein-corruption-has-passed-away,

**7:108** intemperance-has-come-to-an-end, infidelity-has-been-cut-off, and-righteousness-has-grown-and-faithfulness-has-sprung-up.

**7:109** Therefore-then-no-one-will-then-be-able-to-have-mercy-on-him-who-has-been-condemned-in-the-judgment, nor-to-harm-him-who-is-victorious.

**7:110** Then-I-answered-and-said: This-is-my-first-and-last-word: it-had-been-better-if-the-earth-had-not-produced-Adam, or-else, having-produced-him, had-restrained-him-from-sinning.

**7:111** For-what-profit-is-it-for-all-men-to-live-in-sorrow-now-and-to-expect-punishment-after-death?

**7:112** O-Adam, what-have-you-done? For-though-it-was-you-who-sinned, the-evil-was-not-yours-alone: it-is-also-ours-who-are-your-descendants.

**7:113** For-what-profit-is-it-to-us-if-the-immortal-time-is-promised-to-us, whereas-we-have-done-the-works-that-bring-death?

**7:114** And-that-to-us-is-foretold-an-everlasting-hope, whereas-we-in-our-miserable-state-have-come-to-a-wretched-end?

**7:115** Or-that-there-are-laid-up-for-us-habitations-of-health-and-safety, whereas-we-have-lived-wickedly?

**7:116** Or-that-the-glory-of-the-Most-High-is-to-protect-those-who-have-conducted-themselves-purely, whereas-we-have-walked-in-most-wicked-ways?

**7:117** Or-that-the-paradise-shall-be-revealed-whose-fruit-endures-incorruptible-and-therein-is-abundance-and-healing — but-we-shall-not-enter-it,

**7:118** for-we-have-walked-through-unpleasant-places?

**7:119** Or-that-the-faces-of-those-who-practised-abstinence-shall-shine-more-than-the-stars, whereas-our-faces-shall-be-blacker-than-darkness?

**7:120** For-we-did-not-think-in-our-lifetime when-we-committed-iniquity, that-after-death-we-should-suffer-for-it.

**7:121** Then-he-answered-and-said: This-is-the-meaning-of-the-contest-which-every-man-who-is-born-on-earth-wages:

**7:122** that-if-he-is-defeated-he-shall-suffer-what-you-have-said, but-if-he-is-victorious-he-shall-receive-what-I-have-said.

**7:123** For-this-is-the-way-of-which-Moses-while-he-was-alive-spoke-to-the-people, saying: Choose-life-that-you-may-live.

**7:124** But-they-believed-him-not, neither-did-they-believe-the-prophets-after-him, nor-even-myself-who-have-spoken-to-them,

**7:125** so-that-it-shall-not-be-a-grief-to-them-that-they-have-suffered-torment, so-much-as-it-shall-be-that-they-have-forsaken-the-Most-High, despised-his-law, and-forsaken-his-ways.

**7:126** And-those-who-now-dwell-in-it-shall-not-fast-for-those-who-perished, but-they-shall-joy-over-them, because-the-number-of-those-like-themselves-is-now-complete; in-that-the-torment-of-those-who-are-preserved-henceforth-is-at-an-end, whereas-the-glory-of-those-who-are-now-justified-cannot-decrease.

**7:127** And-he-answered-me-and-said: When-he-thought-good-to-save-Israel and-take-them-to-himself, one-did-not-say to-the-other in-Egypt that-they-should-have-pity-on-them;

**7:128** but-he-sent-signs-and-wonders to-rescue-them-from-Egypt and-to-bring-them-safe-through-a-difficult-way.

**7:129** So-also-will-I-do-with-those-who-are-now-in-the-end; I-will-not-grieve-over-the-multitude-of-those-who-perish.

**7:130** For-they-also-received-freedom, but-despised-the-Most-High-and-scorned-his-law-and-forsook-his-ways.

**7:131** Moreover-they-have-trampled-on-his-righteous-ones.

**7:132** They-have-said-in-their-hearts: There-is-no-God; though-knowing-that-they-must-die.

**7:133** For-as-the-things-aforesaid-shall-receive-you, so-thirst-and-torment-which-are-prepared-shall-receive-them; for-the-Most-High-did-not-will-that-man-should-perish.

**7:134** But-man-himself-who-is-created-has-defiled-the-name-of-him-who-made-him, and-has-been-ungrateful-to-him-who-prepared-life-for-him.

**7:135** And-therefore-my-judgment-is-now-near.

**7:136** Which-I-have-not-shown-to-all-men-but-only-to-thee-and-a-few-like-thee.

**7:137** Then-I-answered-and-said: O-LORD, behold, you-have-shown-me-a-multitude-of-signs which-you-will-do-in-the-last-time but-you-have-not-shown-me-when-you-will-do-them.

**7:138** And-he-answered-me-and-said: Measure-the-time-carefully-in-your-mind; and-when-you-see-that-a-portion-of-the-signs-has-passed-which-I-foretold,

**7:139** then-shall-you-understand-that-it-is-the-very-time-when-the-Most-High-is-about-to-visit-the-world-which-he-has-made.

**7:140** Therefore-when-there-shall-be-seen-in-the-world-earthquakes-of-peoples, disorder-of-nations, intrigues-of-kings, confusion-of-leaders, disquietude-of-princes — then-shall-you-understand and-at-that-time-shall-you-recognize-that-the-Most-High-spoke-these-words-to-you.
